features.feature: Process facts affecting phase, review, test, DONE, finding/pass, evidence, branch/worktree, and cleanup are treated as policy metadata with hard CLI/handler/gate fallback, not only prompt prose.
features.covered_by: CHK-001 central process fact registry; CHK-002 review fact schema; CHK-003 express verification policy; CHK-004 regression smoke/contract coverage

features.feature: Typed registry is the single process-fact source and is assembled from COMMAND_POLICIES plus PROCESS_FACT_LEVELS with reviewer lanes, artifacts, L4 consumer gates, and required semantics.
features.covered_by: CHK-001 files include process-fact-registry.ts, process-fact-levels.ts, scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs; CHK-001 happy/edge intents require registry facts and L4 gate checks

features.feature: scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs must be updated so MAIN_TOOLS, DEFAULT_PHASE_TOOLS, reviewer lanes, signed/gate artifacts, L4 gate evidence, and required semantic facts fail loudly on drift.
features.covered_by: CHK-001 modify/test includes scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs; CHK-004 modify/test includes scripts/verify-process-fact-contract.mjs; plan.md CHK-001 and CHK-004 explicitly name the script

features.feature: Review pass is not a finding: no-blocker results must be review_pass_set, pass-only finding_add is normalized, ambiguous pass plus failure language remains a finding.
features.covered_by: CHK-002 happy/edge/adversarial intents cover pass-only conversion, ambiguous language, and non-reviewer attribution; CHK-004 smoke covers pass-only records not appearing as findings
features.source: CLAUDE.md process fact execution rules; story-lifecycle.md:107

features.feature: Finding schema remains constrained at process-fact boundaries, including canonical category/role/severity semantics and existing legacy category normalization.
features.covered_by: CHK-002 includes handlers/finding.ts and core/types.ts; CHK-001 registry semantics cover finding_add/finding_resolve/finding_dismiss; CHK-004 field regression and process contract tests are in scope
features.source: CLAUDE.md process fact execution rules; story-lifecycle.md:104,108

features.feature: reviewRound is consistently treated as an ISO string across runtime types, docs, finding output, and smoke assertions without breaking signed history compatibility.

features.feature: Express verificationIntent bypass is explicit, machine-readable, and limited to computeChannel(...)=express; normal/fast/risky stories with zero intent keep missing-intent behavior.

features.feature: Validation and verification evidence facts remain gate artifacts: validate, verification_evidence_*, and test-evidence.json are represented in registry/contract and tested with phase-aware outputs.
features.covered_by: CHK-001 registry/contract scope; CHK-003 verifier/workflow output scope; CHK-004 smoke/contract commands

features.feature: No parallel policy table is introduced that can drift from process-fact-registry.

features.feature: Runtime/environment facts such as CLI entrypoint, global core realpath, project-local bin, Node/package version, validate source, and external-reference-policy stay out of process-fact-registry.
